summary: A pressable control that stays on or off until pressed again, for one setting such as bold (Web Component).

variant.note: Variants: tertiary adds a border and a shadow.

size.note: Sizes: 32/36/40px high, at least as wide as high.

selected.note: On state. Toggled by click, Enter or Space; reflected as aria-pressed on the inner button.

disabled.note: Native disabled: dimmed, not interactive, out of the tab order.

anatomy.name: button
anatomy.notes: Native <button aria-pressed> in the shadow root; receives focus and keyboard input.

default.notes: Text, an icon, or both. An icon-only toggle needs aria-label on the host.

change.note: Fired after a person toggles it. Not fired when the selected property is set from code.

click.note: Pointer, Enter or Space. Cancelled while disabled.

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: Default slot text. Host aria-label is forwarded to the inner button. aria-labelledby and aria-describedby are not forwarded: ID references do not resolve across shadow roots (SB-0009).

formAssociation.note: A toggle is an action button with state, not a form field: it submits nothing. It is formAssociated only to follow <fieldset disabled>.

accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once per element, when there is no text and no aria-label.
aria: aria-pressed="true" or "false" on the native button (APG toggle button pattern); the label does not change with the state
slotted icons are decorative; the label or aria-label names the control

useCases.when: A formatting or view option that is on or off and takes effect at once

antiPatterns.pattern: Toggle for a setting saved with a form

antiPatterns.why: aria-pressed already announces the state; a changed label reads as a double state
antiPatterns.alternative: Keep the label, let aria-pressed carry the state

antiPatterns.why: The button has no accessible name

coverage: native button with aria-pressed, named by label
click/Enter/Space flip and fire one composed change
on, hover and tertiary colors from component tokens
axe clean (matrix, pressed, tertiary, icon-only, disabled)

drift.realization: the visual reference uses ring/50 plus border-ring; changed for WCAG 1.4.11
same as the visual reference; light muted is neutral-50 (SB-0004), so the hover fill is subtle

the visual reference shows pressed with an accent fill only (about 1.1:1 against the page); a pressed item also gets a foreground border so the state reaches 3:1 without relying on the fill (WCAG 1.4.11, 1.4.1)

coverage: Toggle: 48 variant(s), Variant (Ghost, Tertiary) x Size (Medium, Small, Large) x State (Rest, Hover, Focus) x Selected (False, True) x Disabled (False, True); read back ok

openQuestions.question: Is Toggle form-associated?
openQuestions.recommendation: No: it is a stateful action button and submits nothing (it is a button, not a field). It only follows <fieldset disabled> through formDisabledCallback, like Button.
openQuestions.answer: Not a form field. formAssociated only for fieldset disabled.

openQuestions.question: Controlled or uncontrolled selected state?
openQuestions.recommendation: Uncontrolled with a selected property: a click flips it and fires change; code can set it.
openQuestions.answer: selected property, flipped by the person, change event with detail.selected.
